profile.headline: Lifelong Learner | Educator | Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Peace and love everyone, 

My name Is Andre Campbell. I am a graduate of Howard University with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science.

I am passionate about increasing the representation of black people in STEM by providing more black students the opportunity to explore and learn about computer science. I truly believe that technology should meet the needs of those that use it, which means that those that use it should have a voice in the development process. Simple 

Have something you want to chat with me about? Let's connect.

projects.title: Web Platform Test Auto Import Process
projects.description:
** Parts of this project is internal only to Google, therefore only link available is to a public portion of the code. **

Designed and implemented an automatic web-platform-test import process for Google's Chromium Project. This project encompassed programming a virtual machine to retrieve tests from W3C repository, run the test locally, and based on test results, decide what to do with each test before committing the new tests into the chromium repository. 

This project was developed during the summer of 2016 with Google's Blink Infrastructure team. 

This project is currently being used by Chromium's WPT team.
